root_idea.summary: The root centers on striking or causing forceful impact.
root_idea.development: From physical striking, the root extends to mutual combat, drawing lots, restraint, rebuke, rejection, and names for things that strike people, such as a calamity. Related developments also describe what is relied upon or selected as best.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole supplied Quranic form group is displayed under the normalized nominal citation form قَارِعَة.

senses.definition: A striking or sudden calamity; the overwhelming catastrophe that falls upon people.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, it is used indefinitely for a disaster and as a definite designation for the overwhelming eschatological calamity, including the event described in Sūrat al-Qāriʿah.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or beat a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction قَرَعَ فِي مِقْرَعِهِ is equated with striking in one's striking place. The idiom of striking a vessel against the forehead after emptying it is a contextual application of this physical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To impugn a person's character, blame, censure, or speak against him.
To flip with the nail of the thumb against the nail of the forefinger.
To reject, repel, or turn back a suitor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This idiomatic use is specifically described in the context of a marriage proposal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reproach or rebuke someone for a crime or similar fault.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action is expressed by addressing the person with an accusation of what he has done.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take, obtain, or win a bet, wager, or stake.
To engage in mutual striking or combat.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of opponents striking or confronting one another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cast lots against another person or take part in a drawing of lots.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the reciprocal lot-drawing use of the form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To arrange or order people to cast or draw lots among themselves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The supplied lexical evidence also records a usage in which the subject casts or draws lots among them; the ordering or arranging interpretation is preferred.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To check or rein an animal with its bridle.
A stallion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is explained through the stallion's mounting of the female.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Receptive to advice or counsel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression describes a person who accepts what an adviser says; the opposite is expressed by لَا يُقْرَعُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To return to the truth.
A master or person relied upon in affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The designation is extended to someone on whom people depend and whom they frequently consult; مَقْرُوعٌ is also reported for this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone the choicest part of one's property.
The choicest or best part of one's property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is associated with property relied upon in times of need.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The best house in a quarter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its selection depends on the best shelter in cold weather and the best shade in hot weather.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Loss of the hair of the head; baldness.
A tapeworm, or worms in the belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The name is explained by the resemblance of the worm's joints to gourd seeds.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bare pieces of ground amid herbage.
A lot used in sortilege; lots collectively; or sortilege itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related expression ضَرَبَ القُرْعَةَ means to shuffle, cast, or draw lots, or to practise sortilege.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The trodden or beaten part of a road.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In legal usage it may denote the road's sides or edges, contrasted with its main highway or جَادَّة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A whip or implement used for beating, especially an implement for beating animals.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can refer broadly to an object used to beat, and specifically to a stick used with beasts, including mules and asses.

cautions: The Quranic calamity sense of قَارِعَة is distinct from the Classical construction قَارِعَةُ الطَّرِيقِ, which denotes part of a road.
